_comment: merges this over manifest.json to build kipideck-extension-firefox.zip, and ships
manifest.json unmodified in the Chromium package. tools/ is not in the packaging list,
so this file never ships inside either zip.
Why a separate overlay instead of declaring both keys in manifest.json:
- Chromium's MV3 background is `service_worker`; Chrome tolerates `scripts` locally
from Chrome 121, but the Edge Add-ons upload validator rejects the package with
"The background.scripts field cannot be used with manifest version 3".
- Firefox's MV3 background is a non-persistent event page declared with `scripts`;
it does not support `service_worker` (Firefox bug 1573659), and before Firefox
121 the event page never started at all when `service_worker` was also present
(bug 1860304) — so the Firefox package must not contain it, or every user below
121 gets an extension whose background is silently dead.
So each package must contain only the key its browser understands.
Merge rule: keys here replace the same key in manifest.json, recursively. A null
value deletes that key from manifest.json.
